# Agoura Hills Dental Designs

> Third-generation cosmetic and family dental practice serving Agoura Hills, Calabasas, Westlake Village, Malibu, Thousand Oaks, and Oak Park. Led by Drs. Shawn and David Matian. Same-day appointments; emergency care; cosmetic, restorative, and implant dentistry.

- Address: 28632 Roadside Dr #270, Agoura Hills, CA 91301
- Phone: (818) 706-6077
- Hours: Mon-Thu 8am-5pm, Fri 8am-3pm

## Services

- [Dental implants](https://agourahillsdentaldesigns.com/dental-implants): Single implants $3,500-$4,200, implant bridges $8,000-$9,000.
- [All-on-4 implants](https://agourahillsdentaldesigns.com/all-on-4-dental-implants-agoura-hills): Full-arch restoration $22,000-$27,000 per arch.
- [Dental implant cost](https://agourahillsdentaldesigns.com/dental-implant-cost-agoura-hills): Transparent pricing and financing options.
- [Invisalign](https://agourahillsdentaldesigns.com/invisalign): Clear aligner orthodontics for teens and adults.
- [Veneers](https://agourahillsdentaldesigns.com/veneers): Porcelain veneers $1,500-$2,000 per tooth.
- [Teeth whitening](https://agourahillsdentaldesigns.com/teeth-whitening): In-office and take-home whitening.
- [Dental bonding](https://agourahillsdentaldesigns.com/dental-bonding-agoura-hills): Chip and gap repair.
- [Restorative dentistry](https://agourahillsdentaldesigns.com/restorative-dentistry): Crowns, bridges $4,000-$4,500, dentures $2,000-$2,500 per arch, snap-on dentures $15,000-$16,000.
- [Root canal treatment](https://agourahillsdentaldesigns.com/root-canal-treatment-agoura-hills): Endodontic therapy.
- [Wisdom teeth removal](https://agourahillsdentaldesigns.com/wisdom-teeth-removal-agoura-hills): Extractions with sedation options.
- [Emergency dentistry](https://agourahillsdentaldesigns.com/emergency-dentistry): Same-day pain relief, broken teeth, abscesses.
- [Sedation dentistry](https://agourahillsdentaldesigns.com/sedation-dentistry): Nitrous, oral sedation, IV sedation.
- [Smile analysis](https://agourahillsdentaldesigns.com/smile-analysis): Free AI-powered smile preview.

## Insurance

Most PPO plans accepted. Insured patients typically have 50-80% coverage for common procedures. We verify benefits before treatment and provide accurate out-of-pocket estimates.
